name: pack
description: PACK: Prefix-Adaptive Compression Kernel. Hardware Huffman compressor.

registers.name: OUTPUT
registers.desc: pop one compressed byte (or 0xFFFF if empty)

registers.name: CONTROL
registers.desc: bit 0 = flush, bit 1 = reset, bit 2 = decompress mode

registers.name: STATUS
registers.desc: bits [7:0] = output FIFO count, bit 8 = compress mode
